name: Sous Chef
description: Prep dishes, run the line, and plate everything to perfection.

successMessages: Your knife skills dazzled the head chef. Apron up!
failureMessages: They need more restaurant experience. Stage for a night and reapply.

successMessages: You kept the tickets flowing and every dish came out hot.
Tonight's specials sold out thanks to your plating finesse.
Zero remakes and rave reviews—service was silky smooth.
bonusMessages: The chef shared tips from the VIP table.
A food critic praised your dish, and management added a bonus.
failureMessages: A sauce split mid-service and slowed the whole line.
Burnt garnish meant remaking plates at your expense.
